functions.args: queue_name text, message jsonb, delay_seconds integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION messaging.send(queue_name text, message jsonb, delay_seconds integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select pgmq.send(queue_name, message, delay_seconds);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.send_tick()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select messaging.send('worker', jsonb_build_object(
    'id', t.id,
    'type', 'scheduler.tick',
    'version', 1,
    'occurredAt', to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
    'correlationId', t.id,
    'causationId', null,
    'payload', '{}'::jsonb))
  from (select gen_random_uuid()::text as id) t;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_trusted_users(owner_uuid text)
 RETURNS SETOF users
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  SELECT u.* 
  FROM trusted t
  JOIN users u ON t.trusted_id = u.id
  WHERE t.owner_id = owner_uuid;
$function$
